tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Page and app background. Dark is the default theme.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Windows, panels and the dial ring, on `night`.

tokens.name: night-sunk
tokens.usage: Title bars, command fields, the dial centre and the closing band.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and row separators only. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Borders of controls: secondary buttons, the language switch, command fields. At least 3:1 on `night`, `night-raised` and `night-sunk`.

tokens.name: moon
tokens.usage: Primary text on `night`, `night-raised` and `night-sunk`. Also the fill of the main button.

tokens.name: haze
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `night`, `night-raised` and `night-sunk`.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The only ornament: dial hand, logo, focus ring, coffee button. Readable as text on `night`, `night-raised` and `night-sunk`.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brass` fill.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Soft halo behind the week dial. Never behind text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status text for applied updates, on `ok-bg`.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the applied badge.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: Status text for items waiting for a decision, on `wait-bg`. Also the quiet hours arc on the dial.

tokens.name: wait-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the waiting badge.

tokens.name: back
tokens.usage: Status text for rollbacks and never rules, on `back-bg`.

tokens.name: back-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the rolled back badge.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The app name in a hero. Size with `step-3`.

styles.name: dial-time
styles.usage: The time in the centre of the week dial, in SVG units.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The app name next to the logo mark.

styles.name: claim
styles.sample: Your updates run every Sunday at 03:00.
styles.usage: The sentence under the wordmark. Size with `step-1`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You see what ran and what needs your decision.

styles.name: command
styles.usage: Commands only. Never labels or data.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a button or between badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Header gaps and row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Window padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side gutter from 720px up. Below that use 16px.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Command fields.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: App windows, the only large rounded surface.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges and the language switch.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: App windows only. Nothing else casts a shadow.

fluid.note: Every size follows the window, so one system fits the app and the website.

tokens.name: step-0
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: step-1
tokens.usage: Claim line.

tokens.name: step-2
tokens.usage: Headings and tally numbers.

tokens.name: step-3
tokens.usage: Wordmark.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical distance between sections.
